# Owned intelligence transport fixture

`owned.bundle` is generated by the actual `intelstore` full-source preparation,
indexing, sealing and USTAR export path using its owned local TLS fixture. It
contains one authored inert OSV-shaped GHSA record, not downloaded advisory data.
Its synthetic timestamps, generation declarations and source receipts are not
publisher authentication, live-feed qualification or freshness authority.

The portable graph includes the applicable GitHub CC-BY-4.0 notice/license text.
The store key, physical root identity and local acquisition MAC are not exported.
Tests import this transport without granting source authority, exercise real
same-executable workers and export/reimport actual files. They do not call OSV.
